newsitem.title: USA: Unity Bancorp President James Hyman resigns.
newsitem.headline: Unity Bancorp President James Hyman resigns.

text.p: Unity Bancorp Inc said Tuesday it had accepted the resignation of James Hyman as president and chief operating officer.
It said in a statement Hyman had also resigned as president and chief executive officer of First Community Bank, of which Unity is the parent holding company.
"Hyman will also leave the board of directors of both companies," it added.
Unity quoted him as saying he wanted to pursue other interests.
"The board of directors has begun to make plans to name a successor to Mr. Hyman at the bank," it said.

First Community Bank, which has assets of about $195 million, is a commercial bank providing a wide range of business and consumer financial services from branches in Hunterdon, Somerset and Union Counties of New Jersey.
